description.quote: in a layered structure, rather like the layers of an onion.
description.value: Tracking, calorimeter and muon-detector layers arranged concentrically around the beam pipe.

summary.plain: A roughly 12-metre cube built in layers like an onion, so that every kind of particle from a LEP collision was caught by the right layer: tracking near the beam, then calorimeters, then muon detectors on the outside.
summary.technical: General-purpose LEP detector, about 12 m × 12 m × 12 m, arranged as concentric layers of tracking detectors, calorimeters and muon detectors around the beam pipe.

technology.quote: The components of the detector were arranged outside the beam pipe, in a layered structure, rather like the layers of an onion.
technology.value: General-purpose collider detector with tracking, calorimeter and muon layers arranged concentrically around the beam pipe
